messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Dedicated pool "northbeam-dedicated-usw2" reporting multiple GPU evictions and kernel ECC errors on several nodes; auto-drain started. Incident ID INC-20402
Sam (SRE Oncall): Paging @Priya and @Diego. Assigning lead owners. Root ts: 1975012345. I'll start the customer impact note.
Priya - eng-runtime: Oncall here. Priya taking runtime lead. Can Support pull recent ingress metrics and tenant-to-node mapping? Need to know which Northbeam endpoints are affected.
Diego - eng-infra: I can see nodes flagged: nb-node-usw2-07, nb-node-usw2-14, nb-node-usw2-29. nvme errors + ECC spikes on nb-node-usw2-14. Looks like one node got a preemption event right before errors. Could be spot cascade + HW fault.
Tess - support-escalations: Northbeam rep Laura in channel #cust-northbeam-prod: they confirm increased 5xxs on their online-ranking endpoint (rank-online). They've opened a high-priority support window. Laura: "We need minimal disruption to our live traffic; prefer live failover if possible."
Sam (SRE Oncall): Impact summary: dedicated pool capacity degraded; some Northbeam tenants are scheduled on affected nodes. Options: a) immediate cordon+drain and replace hardware (fast but may cause transient errors), b) live route traffic to warm standby in another AZ (requires routing update), c) ask customer to schedule maintenance window (slower). Recommend immediate cordon+drain + warm-standby routing for critical routes.
Priya - eng-runtime: Agree. I'll trigger drain for nb-node-usw2-14 first, ensure KV cache flush and enable per-route fallbacks for rank-online to northbeam-warm-usw2-b. Also will enable request shedding thresholds to protect tails.
Diego - eng-infra: Starting cordon/drain sequence now. Commands:
```
# cordon node
redwoodctl node cordon nb-node-usw2-14
# drain with 120s graceful window
redwoodctl node drain nb-node-usw2-14 --grace-period=120
```
Note: one transformer-processor pod stuck on snapshot write (~95MB). Trying a graceful restart after 45s.
Maya - eng-releases: There's a quantized-llama rollout touching the same pool. Pausing rollout to reduce churn now.
Priya - eng-runtime: Checkpoint: KV flush succeeded on nb-node-usw2-14; most in-flight requests failed over to fallback. Observed 95p latency on fallback +25%, success for rank-online is ~99.2% after switch.
Laura (Northbeam): Thanks. We prioritize correctness over latency for now. We'll tolerate higher latency and cost for a short window. We're throttling non-critical batch jobs. Keep us posted.
Sam (SRE Oncall): Marking incident P1 (customer-impacting). Paging hardware oncall @Ethan to coordinate physical replacement for nb-node-usw2-14.
Ethan - hw-support: ETA for hot-swap blade = ~3 hours (spare available but need datacenter tech). Recommend leave node drained and replace rather than reuse.
Priya - eng-runtime: Noted. I'm moving nb-node-usw2-07 and nb-node-usw2-29 into proactive drain list to avoid cascading evictions. We'll stagger drains to retain capacity.
Diego - eng-infra: Cloud logs show nb-node-usw2-07 had a spot termination notice ~70s before eviction:
```
2026-03-15T20:11:02Z - cloud: spot instance termination notice i-0fgh 
2026-03-15T20:11:10Z - kernel: GPU ECC error on device 0
```
This looks like a mixed preemption + hardware degradation. Marking these nodes DO NOT RETURN_TO_POOL until post-replacement validation.
Maya - eng-releases: Rollout paused. Will only resume after all affected nodes validated as healthy.
Sam (SRE Oncall): On-call handoff note: I'll stay on until replacement completes; check-ins every 30m. Owners: Priya (runtime), Diego (infra), Ethan (hardware). Adding RCA items: better preemption routing, aggressive KV flush timeouts, and automatic warm-standby preference on spot signals.
Priya - eng-runtime: Applying temporary route preference:
```
redwoodctl routing update --tenant=northbeam-prod --route=prefer:northbeam-warm-usw2-b --fallback=northbeam-warm-usw2-a
```
Applied. Monitoring 10m.
Tess - support-escalations: Notified Northbeam: "We're draining degraded GPUs in your dedicated pool and routing traffic to warm standby. Expect transient latency increase; no data lost." Laura acknowledged.
Laura (Northbeam): Appreciate the rapid response. We'll keep our users informed internally.
Priya - eng-runtime: After routing change: rank-online error rate dropped from ~3.8% -> 0.6% over 5 minutes. Tail latency up but within customer's stated tolerance.
Ethan - hw-support: Datacenter ops confirmed spare blade staged. Replacement window scheduled at approx ts 197501 + 2h40m (ETA approx 197501 + 9600). Will post start/complete updates here.
Sam (SRE Oncall): Temporary mitigation checklist:
- [x] Cordon & drain nb-node-usw2-14
- [x] Apply fallback routing
- [x] Pause rollouts touching pool
- [x] Notify customer
- [ ] Physical replacement scheduled (Ethan)
- [ ] Post-incident RCA (assign owners)
Priya - eng-runtime: Note: one transformer-processor pod stalled on a KV snapshot write during eviction (95MB). Action: add backpressure/timeout to KV snapshot flush to avoid blocking node drains.
Diego - eng-infra: Eviction summary:
nb-node-usw2-14: ECC spikes + kernel OOPS -> marked for replacement
nb-node-usw2-07: spot termination + eviction
nb-node-usw2-29: memory pressure -> drained
All three flagged DO_NOT_REUSE until hardware validation complete.
Laura (Northbeam): We're in a 3-hour high-priority window. Please prioritize replacement; if you need us to move any config or allow a temporary IP whitelisting change, say the word.
Sam (SRE Oncall): Will do. Updating incident ticket INC-20402 and Status page. Priya, Diego, Ethan will continue ops. I'll maintain thread and escalate to Eng Leads if further regressions.
Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Status update posted to incident dashboard. Next auto-check in 15m.
Priya - eng-runtime: 45m update: routing stable, Northbeam seeing <1% errors. Drafting postmortem skeleton and logging action items: automatic warm-standby, KV flush timeout, preemption signal flow.
Ethan - hw-support: Replacement started at approx ts 1975014321. New node nb-node-usw2-53 provisioned and passed basic hardware checks. Bringing node back into pool in validated-mode.
Diego - eng-infra: Reintegrated nb-node-usw2-53; ran stress + NVML diagnostics, GPUs healthy. Marking mitigation-complete; will monitor for 2 hours and then close incident unless regressions. RCA meeting scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT.
Laura (Northbeam): Performance back to expected levels. Thank you all for the quick turnaround.
Sam (SRE Oncall): Closing loop: Incident INC-20402 mitigated. Convert to postmortem; assign action items. If anything else appears, reopen this thread.
